title: Anisotropic Minkowski Content for Countably $\mathcal{H}^k$-rectifiable Sets
summary: We study anisotropic Minkowski content for lower-dimensional rectifiable sets. First, we prove that, for every convex body \(C\subseteq\mathbb R^n\), the \(k\)-dimensional \(C\)-anisotropic Minkowski content of every compact \(k\)-rectifiable set exists. We show that it is given by an integral involving the \((n-k)\)-dimensional volumes of the projections of \(C\) onto the approximate normal spaces of the set.
